text:
lia.mendes: Heads-up: rolling out a small G100x micro-pool pilot in Buenos Aires (sa-east-1) today for customers needing low-latency South America inference. Pilot is intentionally small and gated. :rocket:

omar.petrov: Nice — any SLA or reservation rules for the pilot?

lia.mendes: Pilot = no SLA, limited 10-node pool, 7-day reservation window for early adopters. We'll offer guided onboarding only. Billing at standard dedicated rates.

infra-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-g100x-sa-east-1-01 created (10x G100x). Telemetry: enabled.

chris.lee: Ops note: these machines are behind a soft fairshare. Background maintenance may evict non-reserved workloads. Please advise customers to reserve if they need stability.

sales-EMEA: Question from a customer: can we promise steady throughput for latency-critical routes?

lia.mendes: For pilot, tell them "best-effort; recommend 7-day reservation for production-like stability." We'll publish throughput guidance after 48h of telemetry.

ops-runbook: Quick commands for teams:
```
# reserve (pilot)
rcli reserve --region sa-east-1 --gpu G100x --count 1 --days 7
# status
rcli pool status --name dedicated-g100x-sa-east-1-01
# request support
/rdev ticket create --tag dedicated-g100x-sa-east-1 --summary "pilot support"
```

infra-bot: [automated] alert rule created: g100x-sa-east-1-temp (warn 78%, critical 92%).

omar.petrov: Autoscaling?

lia.mendes: Autoscaling disabled for pilot. We'll evaluate enabling burst after pilot metrics look stable.

sales-EMEA: We'll restrict offers to partners and enterprise POCs only. Informing account teams now.

chris.lee: Note for eng-oncall: there is a firmware rollback scheduled in 36h if thermal telemetry spikes >85%. We'll post a maintenance notice before any reboots.

lia.mendes: Follow-up: we'll share a short status update 48h in this thread with utilization and latency p50/p95. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
